create_ProfilerHook: create a ProfilerHook instance to profile CPU and CUDA activities during training
configure_ProfilerHook_tensorboard_trace: configure a ProfilerHook with tb_trace on_trace_ready to export tensorboard trace files
configure_ProfilerHook_log_trace: configure a ProfilerHook with log_trace on_trace_ready to print key averages table
export_ProfilerHook_chrome_trace: export the ProfilerHook collected trace data to a Chrome JSON trace file via json_trace_path
profile_ProfilerHook_by_iteration: profile training performance by iteration instead of epoch using by_epoch False
